description: An attack and decay function generator with CV on both stages and a built-in amplifier, in 2HP

params.text: Bends the envelope curve between exponential, gentle, linear and logarithmic, with the mid positions falling between them
Sets how long the rise takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the fall takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level of the built-in amplifier, 0% to 100%, and of the ENV output as well when 'LVL knob -> ENV out' is ticked

inputs.text: A trigger here runs the attack and decay once, or starts and stops the repeat in Loop mode; its channel count sets the polyphony
Lengthens the attack, one second per volt, added to the A knob
Lengthens the decay, one second per volt, added to the D knob
The signal for the built-in amplifier

outputs.text: That signal at the envelope's level, scaled by the LVL knob

notes: the mode is chosen from the panel menu rather than a switch, and the small light above the jacks shows which: red for Function, yellow for Loop.
a polyphonic cable at the trigger jack gives each channel its own envelope and its own path through the amplifier.
menu: Function (red) — runs attack then decay once for each trigger
Loop (yellow) — repeats attack and decay from a trigger until a second trigger stops it
LVL knob -> ENV out — makes the LVL knob attenuate the ENV output as well as the amplifier
Restart loop on load — with a single-channel trigger cable, carries on looping when Rack loads a patch that was saved while looping
Add Expander — places an eX expander to the right, giving the envelope another signal path

continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
